mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals persistent labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the following 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery phase of the post-2008 expansion, a federal funds rate below 0.1% consistently precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market discounts prolonged monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances during the early recovery phase when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year consumer price inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals heightened inflation concerns, prompting monetary policy tightening expectations that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates strong manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the following 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion phase, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below the prior month's level signals weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances during the late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines from the prior month.
